lens: Newton analysis and synthesis; modern interpretation, no historical endorsement
coverage: Selected primary passages, current targeted technical search, one public discussion; not exhaustive

sources.title: De motu corporum in gyrum
sources.read_depth: Theorem 2 corollaries and Theorem 3 in normalized Latin transcription; no full manuscript-image audit
sources.supports: Inverse force reconstruction from orbit geometry with a limiting construction

sources.title: Opticks, Book III (1718), Query 31
sources.read_depth: Closing analysis/synthesis and occult-qualities paragraphs; selected passages, not whole book
sources.supports: Documented analysis/synthesis method and tentative status of remaining queries
sources.not_evidence_for: Physical truth of every proposed mechanism

sources.title: General Scholium, Principia (1729 translation)
sources.read_depth: Theological discussion and closing cause-of-gravity/subtle-spirit paragraphs
sources.supports: Newton explicitly separates inferred gravitational law from unknown cause and insufficiently tested speculation
sources.not_evidence_for: A discovered quantum field or occult physical force

sources.read_depth: Catalogue and opening outline ff.1r, items on mineral vegetation and latent spirit; later text not fully read

sources.title: Experiments, Add.3973

sources.not_evidence_for: Transmutation or modern interpretation of symbols
